name: pipe2
description: pipe2() creates a pipe, a unidirectional data channel for interprocess communication, similar to pipe(), but allows additional flags to modify the pipe's behavior such as setting it to non-blocking or close-on-exec.

parameters.name: pipefd
parameters.description: Array used to return two file descriptors referring to the ends of the pipe: pipefd[0] for reading and pipefd[1] for writing

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitwise OR of flags to modify pipe behavior, such as O_CLOEXEC, O_NONBLOCK, O_DIRECT, or O_NOTIFICATION_PIPE

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set to indicate the error, and pipefd is left unchanged

errors.description: The per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached
The system-wide limit on the total number of open files has been reached
The user hard limit on memory that can be allocated for pipes has been reached and the caller is not privileged
O_NOTIFICATION_PIPE was passed in flags and support for notifications is not compiled into the kernel
